listing.name: Urban Reign (Urban Reign Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows/Linux packages; own USA PS2 ISO Limits: Beta; game SLUS-21209. Package and setup documented. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 ZIP and native Linux x86-64 package, glibc2.30+ with Vulkan. macOS package not established. Original data: Own Urban Reign USA PS2 disc SLUS-21209 as ISO. Select or place the image through upstream setup, which uses its original executable and game assets. Optional HD textures are separate from the required source disc; other regions/revisions are not established by reviewed README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
